purpose: Non-Mundarica discovery and exact-locator promotion for a recent peer-reviewed Munda ethnographic/megalith study. The work is registered as a new unresolved web lead; participant-derived cultural content remains gated.

records.title: Stories of Ancient Stones: A Living Tradition of Indigenous People (Mundas) in Jharkhand, India
records.rights_note: Publisher PDF states © 2025 'Uchitel' Publishing House. No Creative Commons licence was identified on the article page in this sweep. Public readability is not treated as redistribution permission. Participant-derived oral narratives, interview content, ritual knowledge, pseudonym-linked statements and sensitive cultural information are not promoted for reuse solely because the article is public.
records.scope_note: Relevant to contemporary Munda megalith research in rural Ranchi. The paper reports qualitative ethnographic/participatory methods with 15 Munda participants and states verbal consent, pseudonymity/confidentiality, express permission for sensitive cultural information, and consultation with community leaders/elders. These statements establish study-reported ethics only; they do not establish MLHKP secondary-use consent or community-wide validation.

canonicalization.decision: No matching DOI/title was found in the repository census before registration. Preserve as WEB-MUN-0089 and do not add it to the audited identity total until source-register promotion criteria and rights/cultural-access review are satisfied.
